benchmark.name: Unordered SfM vs COLMAP on ETH3D laser-scan ground truth
benchmark.protocol: ETH3D high-res DSLR undistorted scene reconstructed by both engines from the same images; both scored against the laser-scanner-registered GT poses (dslr_calibration_undistorted/images.txt) by Sim(3) camera-centre RMSE (scripts/compare_sfm_sim3.py). Independent ground truth: neither engine authored the reference. Both engines given the same shared cam-0 pinhole prior (scenes carry up to 4 per-group calibrations).

command.raw: scratchpad export_superpoint_scaled.py --max-dim 3200 --max-keypoints 2048 --device cuda; unordered_sfm_demo --retrieval-topk 12 --min-matches 30 --colmap-style (driver: scratchpad eth3d_battle.py; logs at E:/datasets/eth3d/battle/courtyard/visloc_run/)

hardware.notes: Intel i7-9750H, NVIDIA GTX 1660 Ti 6GB (CUDA both frontends), Windows 11. COLMAP 4.1.0 fa8e3b3 windows-cuda; torch 2.5.1+cu121; SuperPoint extraction at max-dim 3200 (matching COLMAP's default max_image_size), keypoints scaled back to full-res.

notes: Honest negative vs ETH3D laser GT: COLMAP ahead on common-subset accuracy on all three scenes (0.15-0.41cm vs 0.36-17.4cm). Sweep findings: --refine-intrinsics hurts on sparse view graphs; 4096kp takes courtyard 15.24->4.37cm (registration unchanged), saturates on office, worsens terrace. Companion: eth3d-battle-colmap-courtyard-20260706.
